paragraphs: Rabbi Oshshaya bar Shammai [אוששעיא] and Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Bon. Jerusalem Talmud, Ketubbot, chapter 2, halakhah 4: Rabbi Hoshaya son of Rabbi Shammai and Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Bon disagree. See Rabbi Yitzchak son of Rabbi Elazar. Rabbi Mana wrote to him, Jerusalem Talmud, Megillah, chapter 3, halakhah 2.
